summary: The new audit report (ai-os/audits/reporting_module_reaudit_2026-07-27.md) is substantively sound: well-evidenced with real PR numbers, commits, and test runs, honest about its own findings' gaps, and stays within scope; the ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml addition is a correct append-only edit; no .github/workflows/**, schema, auth, or payment paths are touched. However, the PROGRESS.md hunk in this diff wholesale-deletes the accumulated entries for six other already-merged tasks (projexa hierarchical BoQ, reporting-api-gateway, PR #597 fix, HR gaps, PM gaps, dependabot/sharp CVE fix) and replaces the file with only this task's own section. Git history for this file (commit 8dcac366: 'merge: resolve PROGRESS.md + ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml conflicts with main (keep both -- append-only logs)') establishes that PROGRESS.md is an append-only cross-session log by explicit convention, and this branch never merged/rebased against current main before producing this diff, so it silently clobbers that history rather than appending to it -- exactly the kind of cross-session documentation loss the ACTIVE-CLAIMS/COMPLETED.yaml governance layer exists to prevent. Rejecting on that basis; the audit report content itself does not need rework, only the PROGRESS.md conflict needs to be re-resolved by merging/rebasing against main and keeping both (appending this task's section rather than overwriting the file).
issues: PROGRESS.md diff deletes six other tasks' already-merged progress entries instead of appending, violating this repo's own established append-only convention for this file (see commit 8dcac366). Branch was not merged/rebased against current main before this diff was produced. Fix: rebase/merge against main, resolve PROGRESS.md by keeping both (append this task's section after the existing content), and resubmit.
